name: Hydrocarbons, C16-20, solvent-dewaxed hydrocracked paraffinic distn. residue; Cracked gasoil; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained by solvent dewaxing of a distillation residue from a hydrocracked paraffinic distillate. It consists predominantly of hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C16 through C20 and boiling in the range of approximately 360 °C to 500 °C (680 °F to 932 °F). It produces a finished oil having a viscosity of 4,5 cSt at approximately 100 °C (212 °F).]
